notes: Deploy only StackReceiver on Ethereum mainnet (chain 1), with constructor arguments IMD, sIMD vault and LayerZero EndpointV2 in that order, at the addresses listed above. This is the Ethereum end of imd/acc's multichain cashback route. Cashback waits in a RemoteStacker on the source chain (Robinhood Chain first, eid 30416) and crosses through IMD's own LayerZero OFT bridge to Ethereum (eid 30101). IMD mints the bridged amount to the receiver and queues a compose at the endpoint; the payload is abi.encode(address[] traders, uint256[] amounts). The receiver accepts lzCompose only from the endpoint with from == IMD and zero native ETH. Lists must be non-empty, equal in length and sum exactly to the token-authenticated amountLD; composeFrom grants no authority. The first delivery checks sIMD.asset() == IMD and approves the vault once. Each nonzero amount is deposited for its trader; a failed preview, zero-share preview or reverted deposit pays that trader plain IMD instead. An unexpected zero-share deposit result reverts atomically. Delivered and DeliveredPlain report payouts; deliveredFrom(srcEid) and totalDelivered count delivered IMD. A successful delivery distributes its full amount and leaves unrelated stray IMD untouched. The receiver uses SafeERC20 and a reentrancy guard, has no owner, admin, pause or upgrade, and makes no external constructor call. Deployment requires no ETH funding or initialization call. The existing Stacker (0x06909f672301f28a810f78cfe7a754851269f4f0, launch #1409) and ProjectRegistry (0x7f53fa1543c682bb5de3f50c2cf3d1842ae57faa, launch #1495) remain unchanged. RemoteStacker is a separate later launch on Robinhood Chain using the confirmed receiver address. Test doubles and trial contracts are excluded.
